title: Chipa Guasu
description: Chipa Guasu is a dish from Paraguay featuring yellow onion, fresh corn kernels, whole cow milk, queso fresco. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 11 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 43 minutes until set and cooked through.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
